content: How many ears or patients does the ZETA dataset contain?

name: search_docs

content: Documentation: 5 passage(s) for 'How many ears or patients does the ZETA dataset contain?'

The ZETA dataset contains **one ear** (a single right temporal bone from one cadaveric donor). It is not a patient cohort with multiple ears or patients.

Key points:
- ZETA is a single specimen of the OpenEar library [S2]
- The same bone was imaged many times at high resolution, but it represents only one ear [S2]
- While the broader OpenEar dataset includes 8 cadaveric specimens from different donors [S3], ZETA specifically is just one specimen

This means CochleaHub does not have population statistics across multiple ears or patients—comparisons use published reference ranges from other studies instead.
